title: Law to help small businesses hurt by road construction
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a program offering loans, grants, services or materials to small businesses hurt by city construction projects that disrupt traffic for 30 days or more. Loans would be capped at $50,000 per storefront per year with interest no higher than 3 percent, and grants or reimbursements capped at $15,000 per storefront per year. The agency would have to set up an application process and decide on applications within 30 days, then pay out approved awards within 14 days.
